_comment: WHO guideline PDFs used for the knowledge base. The PDFs are NOT committed (the two IMCI documents are 'All rights reserved'); rag/fetch_guidelines.py downloads them from WHO IRIS and checks sha256. Licences were read from each PDF's copyright page and the IRIS item record on 2026-11-17. Page numbers are PDF page numbers (1-based).
